title: Admin Media Management Context Links
problem: Nako needs the current web product frontend to consume backend-computed Management Context Links so Media and Admin surfaces can switch contexts without duplicating authorization or leaking privileged state.

evidence.summary: Opened a focused web frontend lane from CSAPA-040 after confirming backend-computed Management Context Links already exist at /management/context-links and the current product frontend is web/.

Added the web Public Client Management Context Links data-source boundary and shell route resolver, with focused contract coverage for live calls, fixture fallback, safe query params, known route mappings, disabled links, and unknown route names.
Rendered backend-computed Management Context Links in Media detail, library, selected source, and playback diagnostic contexts without importing Admin APIs or exposing unsafe target identifiers.

continue_policy.notes: Map accepted Management Context Link targets into Admin-owned route state or confirmation flows. Mutating actions must remain Admin-owned.
